dependencyInputs.inputs: Source fingerprint for the dependency output: all 39 packages/services package.json files, all 20 dependency patches and the IME installation script, root package.json and bun.lock, nix/node_modules.nix and both nix/scripts normalizers.
dependencyInputs.inputHashMethod: SHA-256 of the concatenated records in relative path order. Each record contains the path bytes, a NUL and the raw SHA-256 file digest.
